title: From county airfield to airliner parking lot
text: Kern County opened the Mojave Airport in 1935. After the attack on Pearl Harbor in December 1941, the Marine Corps took it over and expanded it into a Marine Corps Auxiliary Air Station. Today the airport is also known as a place where commercial airliners are stored, because of the vast area and dry desert conditions.
